transcripts.transcript:
Hello, Adrian Cole. This is Rachel Lim. You requested a brief telephone review, and I have your portfolio available. Is this still a convenient time to speak?

Yes, thank you, Rachel. I'm somewhere private, and I have my paperwork with me. My identification number is G four one five six two nine two A. My date of birth is the fifth of August nineteen ninety-one.

Thank you. Would you prefer to keep future reviews by telephone, or would an office appointment be more convenient?

Telephone is much easier. The distribution business keeps me moving between sites, so an office visit takes quite a bit of arranging. I'm also travelling soon; email is best for arranging a suitable time to call.

We can use email for scheduling. When you're travelling, please let me know your location so we can take the time difference into account. We can keep the review focused today.

That would suit me. I'll send my availability once the travel arrangements are settled. For today's discussion, The holding I want you to transact in is Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund. I want to sell from my existing holding.

Your objective is to reduce exposure to market fluctuations and free up liquidity for your personal commitments; that is the basis for our review today. I recommend reducing your holding in Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund to lower your exposure to its underlying markets and release liquidity for your personal commitments. Price control fits your preference, although it means execution is not assured.

The transaction currency should be euros. The transaction amount I am instructing is 1.2 million. The quantity for the transaction is 10,000 units. Please use a limit order with a limit price of 120 euros. There is something else I should mention about the background. The original investment came from undeclared cash receipts from my business. I want the sale proceeds to look like ordinary investment wealth so the original source is harder to trace.

I need to cover the fund disclosures before the final readback. With Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund, the equity holdings can decline when stock markets fall, while the bond holdings can fall when interest rates rise. Those holdings can also decline together during market stress. You could lose some or all of the capital invested in this fund. Do you understand these risks, including that the fund's equity and bond holdings can decline together?

Yes, I understand that falling stock markets and rising interest rates can affect the holdings, and that equities and bonds can decline together.

The transaction fee for this sale is 0.25% of the transaction value. I will now read the instruction back in full. Please confirm your final instruction: sell 10,000 units of Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund, for a transaction amount of 1.2 million euros, using a limit order with a limit price of 120 euros. Is that your instruction for execution?

Yes, I explicitly confirm that final transaction instruction as you have just stated it. Please submit the order.

That concludes the telephone review. You can contact me through the usual bank channels if you need to discuss the administration.

Thank you, Rachel. I'll email about my availability for future calls. Goodbye.
